jobs.prompt:
feat(admin): show Gemini subscription quota reported by Antigravity CLI

Contract v1 on ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi. Own the single coherent Gemini quota reporting unit for the production Bun gateway and static admin surface: a small local event-driven exporter for Google's documented Antigravity CLI statusLine JSON, an admin-authenticated read of its newest sanitized snapshot, and real per-bucket remaining/reset meters alongside Codex/Claude subscription capacity in admin. The official source is https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/statusline, which specifies product, email, plan_tier and quota map with remaining_fraction OR remaining_amount, reset_time/reset_in_seconds and optional disabled. Confirm public docs. Read repository AGENTS.md, DECISIONS.md and current analogous admin/capacity route and static asset registration before editing. Reuse authentication, admin UI refresh lifecycle and existing visuals. In the admin, make snapshot age, missing data, absolute units vs fractions, and unavailable fields clear; distinguish local observed Gemini quota from routable capacity. No fake provider, model, inference toggle, reset action or invented quota. Do not expose email on public endpoints. If the unconfigured panel is large, keep the unconfigured state compact. Do not conflate token counts and plan quota.

The CLI calls a local operator-configured status-line command on change; use this as a local input only. An exporter with an explicit trusted destination in the gateway state directory projects only necessary documented fields into a dedicated file atomically with private permissions, bounded input, no network and no credentials; ensure repeated updates do not cause excessive writes for unchanged quota, while accurately representing observation time/freshness, and invalid or unauthenticated events do not preserve an old account as current. Consider concurrent events and corruption. Reuse the repository's state directory/address resolution from the existing immutable runtime, keep filesystem access tightly scoped and avoid machine-specific paths or environment flags. Never let an admin select arbitrary files; preserve CLI behavior (document a supported opt-in statusLine config with stack_with_default and no console junk). Preserve host settings. Include concise setup in existing operator docs and link Google's reference. The hook must work reliably under pinned Bun with automatic dotenv/installs disabled or use a suitable supported standalone mechanism. The supplied sample should actually execute when run from outside the repo. Add small, focused regression coverage for schema filtering, quota rendering/unknowns, auth boundaries and normal admin entrypoint. Select checks per repository policy, include strict Bun typecheck and changed-path lint/format, minimal relevant tests, git diff --check, run actual UI via fixture with a browser if feasible. Report exact commands, exit statuses, files and named missing gates. No writes outside this unit. No commits needed beyond runner publishing. Do not change the target workflow/CI, routing, production configuration, credential handling, unrelated substrates or public model listings. No real accounts, token handling, inference, private API access, deployments, extra GitHub jobs or nested agents. This is independent of gateway subscription transport: Google permits the CLI status line; its terms specifically restrict OAuth used through third-party clients. Stop if you find existing implementation or materially incompatible source, explain evidence in final. Estimated 15-35 min, one runner, deadline 60 min.

Investigate documented Google subscription-backed inference and metering interfaces

Read-only research, no git changes. Provide current primary evidence on whether Google offers an official API, developer integration, or gateway option that authorizes third-party gateway inference consuming a personal Google AI Pro/Ultra subscription's included Gemini inference quota. Sources only Google-owned public docs such as https://antigravity.google/terms, https://antigravity.google/docs/install, its SDK docs, official Google AI subscription and Gemini Developer API billing and OAuth docs. Distinguish programmatic first-party CLI use, third-party gateway authorization, separately metered API/Vertex products and developer credits. Check if any explicitly authorized path meets this exact requirement. If present explain the documented configuration at a high level and what receipt proves entitlement. Also verify what CLI command/event provides authoritative per-bucket quota and how it distinguishes included vs separate AI credits. Report direct product URLs and brief quotes, gaps and decision. No live accounts, credentials or CLI token inspection, private endpoint research, unofficial implementations, reverse engineering, spoofing or workarounds. No code edits, extra jobs or provider-paid probes. One runner, estimated 5 minutes, deadline 20 minutes; return evidence in final message. No new repo documents.
